text:
Mira (Partnerships): FYI — Spectra Learning listing is LIVE on EdMarket and the customer has signed a 12-month extension to the pilot. LTI integration merged this morning, they kicked the tires in staging and gave :thumbsup:. Link: https://marketplace.ed/markets/spectra-learning
Sam (AE): Incredible work team — closed the extension and upsell for classroom analytics. Deal paperwork done, PO received. cc @Ana for contract note.
Leah (Customer Success): Onboarding kicked off. I ran the quickstart and verified SSO + LTI launch flow. Notes: learner roster sync needs a small schema tweak (sending patch to @Jordan).
Jordan (Solutions): Patch posted to repo and pushed to staging. Quick snippet for customers who need to map SIS IDs: ```PATCH /v1/sync { "sis_id_field": "student_number" }``` Tested w/ Spectra sandbox.
marketplace-bot: Listing status: published -> public. View at https://marketplace.ed/marketplace/spectra-learning (verified 11:02am UTC).
Noah (Marketing): Nice! Can we get a short customer quote for the case study? Suggested timeline: interview this week, publish next Tue. I can draft press blurb + tweet.
Mira (Partnerships): @Noah yes, good call. Sam — can you get a 1-2 line quote from their VP of Product? Leah — can you coordinate a 30m interview (recorded) and drop notes in the playbook?
Sam (AE): Yep — asking for a quote now. ETA EOD.
Leah (Customer Success): Blocked slot: Thu 10:30am PT works for them. I'll add to calendar and include the recording consent. Also uploading onboarding runbook here: https://redwood-internal/repo/playbooks/spectra-onboarding.md
Ana (Legal): Confirmed — MSA amendment signed, marketplace TOS checkbox accepted. No additional redlines.
Jordan (Solutions): FYI integration note for docs team: for customers using >1 LMS, enable `multi_lms=true` in config. Sending PR for docs after I finish test matrix.
Noah (Marketing): Great. I'll draft the case study outline and share a GH doc. Can someone drop a short product screenshot (LTI launch) into the doc?
Mira (Partnerships): @Jordan please drop screenshot; @Sam please push the customer quote into the doc when it arrives. I'll schedule a light co-marketing sync with Spectra next week to coordinate blog + marketplace spotlight.
Sam (AE): Quote received: "Spectra's students saw a 22% improvement in assignment completion with Redwood's inference in-course. Integration was painless." Sending to @Noah now.
Noah (Marketing): Perfect — that quote works. I'll draft the case study and a Marketplace spotlight card. Expect first draft tomorrow.
Leah (Customer Success): Quick note for CS folks: enable short token TTL for sandbox (instructions in runbook) to avoid stale sessions during demo.
Mira (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — huge win for the Edu vertical and our marketplace strategy. :tada: If anyone needs follow-ups, ping me here.
Noah (Marketing): :tada: will set up the doc and tag everyone.
Jordan (Solutions): :rocket:
marketplace-bot: Marketplace analytics event: first 24h impressions=1.2k, installs=36.
Mira (Partnerships): closing thread — saving action items in Asana (Spectra Edu case study): assignees @Noah, @Leah, @Jordan, @Sam.
Noah (Marketing): I'll create the Asana task and link back here. Thanks team!
